sections.h2: What Is Included In Your Free Website Audit

items.text: This is not an automated scan you could run yourself.

Every Free Website Audit Kerala businesses request from Teknoppy is manually reviewed by our in-house SEO and web team, covering on-page SEO, technical SEO, Core Web Vitals and speed, mobile experience, local SEO signals, and content gaps against your top competitors.

Your Free Website Audit Kerala report gives you a written summary explaining the five to eight issues with the biggest impact on your rankings and traffic, ranked by priority, plus a short call or WhatsApp follow-up to walk through the findings.
Delivery lands within three business days.
There is no obligation to hire us after your Free Website Audit Kerala report arrives.
Some businesses fix the issues themselves; others ask Teknoppy to handle it.

sections.h2: Why Businesses Trust Teknoppy's Free Website Audit

items.text: Your Free Website Audit Kerala report is reviewed by the same team that designs, builds, and runs SEO for client websites across Kerala, Kochi, and the GCC, so recommendations come from people who have implemented these fixes before, not a generic checklist.
Findings are written in plain language, prioritised by impact, not a jargon-heavy document meant to scare you into a contract.
Every audit follows the same technical, on-page, and local SEO checklist used before starting any paid SEO engagement.

sections.h2: What A Real Website Audit Report Looks Like

paragraphs.text: A recent Free Website Audit Kerala request from a Kochi-based service business flagged missing alt text across product images, a homepage title tag missing the core service keyword, and a mobile loading time above four seconds.
Each finding came with a plain explanation of the fix and its expected impact, not just a red flag with no context.
